name: Stable Builds Archive
body:
Every patched APK and module this project builds from the **stable patch pools**, collected in one release. This is the cumulative dump — the numbered releases (`260141`, `260140`, …) are the per-run snapshots that say exactly which patches went into a build.

### Which versions stick around
A scheduled cleanup keeps the **two newest versions per app + architecture** here and deletes anything older, so an app you installed last month may already be gone. Numbered releases are pruned by count instead — the newest 98 builds survive — so a version you actually want to keep reachable lives on longer there than in this archive.

### Download
- 🔗 [Website catalogue](https://nullcpy.github.io) — filter by app, brand, variant and architecture (recommended)
- 📂 Or grab the file straight from the assets list below

### Almost always needed alongside
- 🧩 [MicroG-RE](https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE/releases/latest) or [ReVanced MicroG](https://github.com/ReVanced/GmsCore/releases/latest) — required for Google apps (YouTube, Maps, Photos, …)
- 🛡 [Zygisk Detach](https://github.com/j-hc/zygisk-detach) — stops the Play Store from overwriting a patched app with its stock update

Want an app added or a patch enabled? Open an issue or ask in the group.

name: Beta Builds Archive
body:
Every patched APK and module built from the **beta patch pools**, collected in one release. These are builds made against pre-release / development versions of the patch sources (`patches-version = "beta"`), plus the apps configured for `both` pools — so the same app can appear here *and* in the [stable archive](https://github.com/nullcpy/rvb/releases/tag/stable).

### Expect rougher edges
A beta build tracks whatever the patch author pushed last: a feature may be half-finished, an app version may be ahead of what the patches officially support, and a source can break and get fixed again within a day. This release is marked **pre-release** on GitHub, exactly like the numbered beta builds whose assets are merged into it — that badge is the signal to treat everything here as test-only. Use the [stable archive](https://github.com/nullcpy/rvb/releases/tag/stable) unless you are deliberately testing a new patch set.

### Which versions stick around
A scheduled cleanup keeps the **two newest versions per app + architecture** here and deletes anything older. Beta churns faster than stable, so files here are shorter-lived — the newest 98 numbered builds keep their assets far longer.
